# apple_game_center_achievements (Data Source)

Lists the Game Center achievements of an app or of a group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_achievements" "app" {
  game_center_detail_id = data.apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  archived              = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) `true` lists only archived achievements, `false` only the others. Unset lists every achievement.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of an app's Game Center detail. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.

### Read-Only

- `achievements` (Attributes List) The achievements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--achievements))

<a id="nestedatt--achievements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `achievements`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the achievement is archived.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the achievement.
- `points` (Number) Points the achievement is worth.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the achievement in App Store Connect.
- `repeatable` (Boolean) Whether players can earn the achievement more than once.
- `show_before_earned` (Boolean) Whether players see the achievement before they earn it.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game reports the achievement with.
